title: CARTO vector basemap collapses to background color when zoomed out past its tile grid
answers: Geomap panel shows a flat/blank color when zoomed out
CARTO basemap renders as solid background instead of map
Small geomap panel (under 512px) shows no map tiles
Why does the CARTO vector basemap go blank at low zoom levels?
body:
Symptom: a geomap panel using the CARTO vector basemap renders as the style's flat background color instead of the map, especially when the panel's largest dimension is under 512px.
Root cause: OpenLayers measures zoom in 256px worlds but CARTO's vector tiles are 512px, so the tile grid runs out one zoom level short of view zoom 0; ol-mapbox-style then converts the OL resolution into a negative style zoom and every style rule falls below its first zoom stop (public/app/plugins/panel/geomap/layers/basemaps/carto.ts:clampStyleToWidestTile).
Fix pattern: wrap the layer's style function so the resolution passed to it is clamped to tileGrid.getResolution(tileGrid.getMinZoom()) — i.e. never style with a resolution wider than the widest tile the grid actually covers.
Constraints: applies to any vector-tile basemap/source whose tile size differs from OL's 256px assumption; don't apply to raster sources (no style-zoom math) or to vector tile grids whose tile size already matches 256px, since there's no gap to clamp.
applies: geomap panel, CARTO/vector-tile basemap style functions using ol-mapbox-style
